coverage_summary: Bounded daily scan of primary evidence on capital costs (US Treasury), industrial demand (China NBS), and previously registered electricity infrastructure/financing signals (World Bank Uzbekistan and Asia DRIVE). No new independently verified project execution, regulatory trigger, physical commissioning or actual disbursement establishes a distinct structural opportunity. Market repricing alone is not a structural transition.
